mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM places WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT t.name FROM tags t JOIN place_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.id JOIN places p ON p.id=pt.place_id AND p.user_id=t.user_id WHERE pt.place_id = #{placeId} AND p.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY t.name
mapper.sql: p.id, p.user_id, p.name, p.city, p.address, p.category, ST_X(p.position) AS longitude, ST_Y(p.position) AS latitude, p.coordinate_system, p.coordinate_status, p.coordinate_source, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.favorite, p.visited, p.notes, p.source_url
mapper.select: SELECT FROM places p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.city ILIKE '%' || #{city} || '%' AND p.category = #{category} AND (p.name ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR p.address ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%') ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT FROM places p WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM places p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.position IS NOT NULL AND ST_Intersects(p.position, ST_MakeEnvelope(#{minLng}, #{minLat}, #{maxLng}, #{maxLat}, 4326)) ORDER BY p.name LIMIT 1000
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO places (id, user_id, name, city, address, category, position, coordinate_status, coordinate_source, favorite, visited, notes, source_url) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{request.name}, #{request.city}, #{request.address}, #{request.category}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{request.longitude}, #{request.latitude}), 4326)NULL, 'user_confirmed''pending', 'manual user input'NULL, COALESCE(#{request.favorite},false), COALESCE(#{request.visited},false), COALESCE(#{request.notes},''), #{request.sourceUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE places SET name = #{request.name}, city = #{request.city}, address = #{request.address}, category = #{request.category}, position = ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{request.longitude}, #{request.latitude}), 4326)NULL, coordinate_status = 'user_confirmed''pending', coordinate_source = 'manual user input'NULL, favorite=COALESCE(#{request.favorite},favorite), visited=COALESCE(#{request.visited},visited), notes=COALESCE(#{request.notes},notes), source_url=COALESCE(#{request.sourceUrl},source_url), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE trip_stops SET place_id=NULL, updated_at=now() WHERE place_id=#{id} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips WHERE trips.id=trip_stops.trip_id AND user_id=#{userId})
UPDATE places SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM place_tags WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM places WHERE id=#{placeId} AND user_id=#{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_tags (place_id, tag_id) SELECT #{placeId}, t.id FROM tags t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.name IN #{tag} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
